newsitem.title: UK: Guinness Peat in talks to buy out Gowrings.
newsitem.headline: Guinness Peat in talks to buy out Gowrings.

text.p: UK life assurance to investment company Guinness Peat Group said on Monday it was in acquisition talks with Gowrings, the UK motor dealerships to fast food outlets company in which it has a 14 percent stake.
Guinness Peak said it hoped to extend weekend talks with a view to secure a recommendation from Gowrings at a price of not less than 90 pence per share cash with a loan note alternative.
"These discussions may or may not lead to an offer," Guinness Peat said in a statement.
It noted that Gowrings' prospects were limited by "the modest scale of its businesses" and that it would benefit from being part of a larger group.
